verdictRationale: G0/G1/G3 shared gates pass at this SHA and the packet's factual claims are proven, not asserted: 10/10 real-Postgres tests confirm the fail-closed publish/usage gates work today, all four segregation-of-duties guards are wired at their call sites, and two real gaps (GAP 1 read-path filtering, GAP 2 legacy ISO 27001 preset bypass) are identified with evidence rather than hidden. This task is BLOCKED_OWNER by design: activating any named external standard, and deciding the fate of the legacy ISO 27001 preset, are Product + Methodology/Rights + Legal decisions this lane may not take (explicitly stated in the decision packet itself). The engineering-verifiable half of this task (does the fail-closed default actually hold today) is DONE; the decision half cannot be closed by this lane regardless of code quality.
